messages.text: Feel better Chris and Dakota, thanks for being honest. I feel fine but I was around you both, so I'm skipping the game and party tonight and staying low-key, masking. Wynn, maybe rethink the party. Text me if you need anything!

response.thoughts: Chris tested positive and Dakota, who I hung out with last night, now has a fever. I feel fine, but I was around Dakota and Chris, so I'm a lot more worried. I'll sleep in, skip the crowded football game and the party to avoid spreading anything if I'm incubating. I'll do low-risk stuff: grab food, a masked outdoor walk, and let friends know I'm staying careful. I'll keep an eye out for symptoms.
